card.name: Ending of capitalized DOSAGE heading
card.fires_on: The final piece (AGE or ING) of the word DOSAGE or DOSING when it is written in capital letters as a section heading in a drug label.

modes.label: DOSAGE in caps
modes.description: AGE completes an all-caps DOSAGE heading, often at the start of a dosing section.
modes.example: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION DOS<<AGE>> SHOULD BE INDIVIDUALIZED ACC

modes.label: DOSING in caps
modes.description: ING completes an all-caps DOSING heading before a route, volume or table title.
modes.example: ADULT INTRAMUSCULAR DOS<<ING>>: Refer to the Preparation for Administration section

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward starting other words rather than a clear next word, so the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires when the capitalized heading word DOSAGE or DOSING is being finished in a drug label.
